```{r setup, include=FALSE}

if (!file.exists("R/bl_api.R")) {
  stop("Knit from the project root (folder containing R/bl_api.R).")
}
source("R/bl_api.R")
source("R/bl_marylebone.R")
source("R/bl_report_map.R")
bl_load_env()

site_code <- params$site_code
if (is.null(site_code) || !nzchar(site_code)) {
  site_code <- bl_resolve_report_site_codes()[1]
}
bl_use_site_code(site_code)

packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "ggplot2", "cowplot", "tidyr", "lubridate"
)
invisible(lapply(packages, require, character.only = TRUE))

# BL_DATA_SOURCE=csv (default) or api — see .env.example
report_data <- bl_load_report_data(site_code = site_code)
NO2_DATA_FRAME <- report_data$no2
PM25_DATA_FRAME <- report_data$pm25

report_dates <- bl_env_report_dates(site_code = site_code)
organisation_name <- bl_site_organisation_name(site = site_code)
quarter_start <- report_dates$quarter_start
quarter_end <- report_dates$quarter_end
measurement_start <- report_dates$fetch_start
report_year <- report_dates$report_year
report_quarter <- report_dates$report_quarter

quarter_label <- paste0("Q", report_quarter)
summary_to_date_heading <- sprintf(
  "Summary of data to date (%s to present)",
  sprintf(
    "%d %s %s",
    lubridate::day(measurement_start),
    format(measurement_start, "%B"),
    format(measurement_start, "%Y")
  )
)
report_title_line1 <- sprintf("Quarter %d", report_quarter)
report_title_line2 <- "Air Quality Trends Report"
report_title_line3 <- sprintf(
  "%s to %s %s",
  sprintf("%d %s", lubridate::day(quarter_start), format(quarter_start, "%B")),
  sprintf("%d %s", lubridate::day(quarter_end), format(quarter_end, "%B")),
  report_year
)
plot_legend_labels <- c("All data to date", quarter_label)

quarter_trend_texts <- c(
  "(Q1) Jan-March: In this quarter we may see higher NO\\textsubscript{2} levels if we have some cold winter mornings that trap emissions near the ground. Towards the end of March we may see some particulate episodes as the farming fertiliser season starts and we have some still high-pressure conditions.",
  "(Q2) April-June: We may continue to see some particulate episodes in April as the farming fertiliser season continues and we have high pressure systems creating stagnant conditions. May and June are generally low pollution months.",
  "(Q3) July-Sept: The summer months are when we are likely to see ozone episodes. Ozone is not emitted but rather formed in the atmosphere from other pollutants in the heat of the sun. Generally, ozone (O\\textsubscript{3}) builds through the day peaking between 4-8 PM.",
  "(Q4) Oct-Dec: Autumn is typically a season of lower pollution, with the wind and rain helping to keep pollution low. As we get into December though we do sometimes see winter smogs on cold, clear, crisp mornings where pollution from traffic and heating is trapped near the ground."
)

bl_format_quarter_line <- function(q, text) {
  if (q == report_quarter) {
    sprintf("\\textcolor{blorg}{\\textbf{%s}}", text)
  } else {
    sprintf("\\textcolor{blgrey}{%s}", text)
  }
}

WHO_NO2_DAILY <- 25
WHO_PM25_DAILY <- 15
BL_SPIKE_COOCCURRENCE_QUANTILE <- 0.75
BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS <- 0L

bl_typical_peak_methodology_text <- paste(
  "Typical peak time ranges are based on the day(s) with the highest peak hourly average (within 2\\% of the maximum). The reported range spans up to five contiguous hours centred on the peak hour and includes neighbouring hours with average values at or above 92\\% of the peak."
)
bl_typical_peak_footnote_mark <- "\\textsuperscript{1}"

bl_append_typical_peak_footnote <- function(text) {
  sprintf("%s%s", text, bl_typical_peak_footnote_mark)
}

bl_pollutant_summary <- function(df, value_col, threshold, start_date = NULL, end_date = NULL) {
  period_df <- df %>%
    mutate(day = as.Date(sub(" .*", "", gsub("\\..*", "", date))))

  if (!is.null(start_date)) {
    period_df <- period_df %>% filter(day >= start_date)
  }
  if (!is.null(end_date)) {
    period_df <- period_df %>% filter(day <= end_date)
  }

  values <- period_df[[value_col]]
  values <- values[!is.na(values)]

  daily <- period_df %>%
    group_by(day) %>%
    summarise(
      daily_mean = round(mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (!length(values)) {
    return(list(
      exceed_days = 0L,
      exceed_days_by_year = data.frame(
        year = integer(),
        exceed_days = integer(),
        total_days = integer(),
        exceed_pct = numeric()
      ),
      mean = NA_real_,
      min = NA_real_,
      max = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  exceed_days_by_year <- daily %>%
    mutate(year = lubridate::year(day)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      exceed_days = sum(daily_mean > threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_days = sum(!is.na(daily_mean)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(year)

  list(
    exceed_days = sum(daily$daily_mean > threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    exceed_days_by_year = exceed_days_by_year,
    mean = round(mean(values), BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS),
    min = min(values),
    max = max(values)
  )
}

# Each year's bracketed % is exceedance days as a share of all days with data
# in that calendar year (e.g. 122 of 279 days in 2024 → 43.7%).
bl_add_annual_exceedance_year_pct <- function(by_year) {
  if (!nrow(by_year)) {
    return(by_year)
  }
  by_year$exceed_pct <- ifelse(
    by_year$total_days > 0L,
    round(100 * by_year$exceed_days / by_year$total_days, BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS),
    0
  )
  by_year
}

# Summary-of-data-to-date stats for a quarterly report:
# - Cap all values at quarter_end (ignore rows after the report quarter).
# - Annual exceedance breakdown lists complete prior calendar years only.
# - Report year appears in the breakdown for Q2–Q4 (partial year through quarter_end).
# - Report year is omitted for Q1 (that quarter has its own summary box).
bl_to_date_pollutant_summary <- function(
    df,
    value_col,
    threshold,
    quarter_end,
    report_year,
    report_quarter
) {
  stats <- bl_pollutant_summary(df, value_col, threshold, end_date = quarter_end)
  by_year <- stats$exceed_days_by_year
  if (!is.null(by_year) && nrow(by_year) && report_quarter == 1L) {
    by_year <- by_year %>% filter(year != as.integer(report_year))
  }
  stats$exceed_days_by_year <- bl_add_annual_exceedance_year_pct(by_year)
  stats
}

bl_format_exceedance_days <- function(n) {
  if (n == 0L) {
    return("no days")
  }
  word <- if (n == 1L) "day" else "days"
  sprintf("%d %s", n, word)
}

# Format rounded numbers for display; strip trailing zeros (10.0 → 10).
bl_format_decimal <- function(x, digits = BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS) {
  if (length(x) != 1L) {
    return(vapply(x, bl_format_decimal, character(1), digits = digits))
  }
  if (is.na(x)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  s <- format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
  s <- sub("(\\.[0-9]*?)0+$", "\\1", s)
  sub("\\.$", "", s)
}

# All pollutant concentrations (µg/m³) in the report use whole numbers.
bl_format_concentration <- function(x) {
  bl_format_decimal(x, digits = BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS)
}

bl_format_latex_pct <- function(pct) {
  # LaTeX treats % as a comment; emit \% in the PDF output.
  paste0(bl_format_decimal(pct, digits = BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS), "\\%")
}

bl_format_concentration_stats <- function(stats, period_label) {
  if (is.na(stats$mean)) {
    if (identical(period_label, "To date")) {
      return("No data are available.")
    }
    return("No data are available for this quarter.")
  }
  sprintf(
    "The average concentration was %s µg/m³; the minimum was %s µg/m³; and the maximum was %s µg/m³",
    bl_format_concentration(stats$mean),
    bl_format_concentration(stats$min),
    bl_format_concentration(stats$max)
  )
}

bl_annual_exceedance_year_lines <- function(stats) {
  by_year <- stats$exceed_days_by_year
  if (is.null(by_year) || !nrow(by_year)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  sprintf(
    "%d → %s (%s)",
    by_year$year,
    vapply(by_year$exceed_days, bl_format_exceedance_days, character(1)),
    vapply(by_year$exceed_pct, bl_format_latex_pct, character(1))
  )
}

bl_plot_annual_exceedance_bars <- function(stats, fill_color) {
  by_year <- stats$exceed_days_by_year
  if (is.null(by_year) || !nrow(by_year)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  bar_half <- 0.45
  label_size <- 12
  days_label_size <- 6
  year_label_size <- 24
  grid_breaks <- c(25, 50, 75)

  plot_df <- by_year %>%
    mutate(
      year = factor(as.character(year), levels = as.character(year)),
      exceed_pct = as.numeric(exceed_pct),
      days_label = vapply(exceed_days, bl_format_exceedance_days, character(1)),
      pct_label = paste0(exceed_pct, "%")
    )

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = year)) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = as.numeric(year) - bar_half,
        xmax = as.numeric(year) + bar_half,
        ymin = exceed_pct,
        ymax = 100
      ),
      fill = "grey90",
      colour = NA
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = grid_breaks, colour = "white", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = as.numeric(year) - bar_half,
        xmax = as.numeric(year) + bar_half,
        ymin = 0,
        ymax = exceed_pct
      ),
      fill = fill_color,
      colour = NA
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = year, y = exceed_pct, label = pct_label),
      vjust = -0.12,
      colour = fill_color,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = label_size
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = year, y = 100, label = days_label),
      vjust = -0.35,
      size = days_label_size
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1 - bar_half - 0.12,
      y = grid_breaks,
      label = c("25%", "50%", "75%"),
      hjust = 1,
      colour = "grey65",
      size = 7
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12)),
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = grid_breaks,
      labels = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(1.1, 1.1))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = year_label_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = year_label_size),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 2, 5, 2)
    )
}

bl_format_who_exceedance <- function(stats, pollutant_md, threshold, period_label) {
  if (is.na(stats$mean)) {
    if (identical(period_label, "To date")) {
      return(sprintf(
        "No WHO %s exceedance data are available.",
        pollutant_md
      ))
    }
    return(sprintf(
      "No WHO %s exceedance data are available for this quarter.",
      pollutant_md
    ))
  }
  if (stats$exceed_days == 0L) {
    return(sprintf(
      "No days exceeded the WHO %s daily mean guideline of %d µg/m³.",
      pollutant_md, threshold
    ))
  }
  sprintf(
    "%s exceeded the WHO %s daily mean guideline of %d µg/m³.",
    bl_format_exceedance_days(stats$exceed_days), pollutant_md, threshold
  )
}

bl_emit_annual_exceedance_sub_bullets <- function(stats, period_label) {
  if (!identical(period_label, "To date")) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  year_lines <- bl_annual_exceedance_year_lines(stats)
  if (is.null(year_lines)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat("\\par The annual breakdown was:\\par\n")
  cat("\\begingroup\\setlength{\\parindent}{0pt}\\setlength{\\parskip}{2pt}\n")
  for (line in year_lines) {
    cat(
      "\\noindent\\hangindent=1.25em\\hangafter=1\\textbullet\\enspace ",
      line,
      "\\par\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
  cat("\\endgroup\n")
}

bl_pollutant_latex <- function(pollutant_md) {
  switch(
    pollutant_md,
    "NO~2~" = "NO\\textsubscript{2}",
    "PM~2.5~" = "PM\\textsubscript{2.5}",
    pollutant_md
  )
}

bl_format_marylebone_paragraph <- function(
    selection,
    pollutant_md,
    footnote_mark = NULL) {
  if (is.null(selection)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  pol <- bl_pollutant_latex(pollutant_md)
  x <- bl_format_concentration(selection$headline_community)
  y <- bl_format_concentration(selection$headline_marylebone)

  text <- switch(
    selection$option,
    A = sprintf(
      paste0(
        "Residents may assume that living outside Central London means cleaner air. ",
        "However, during the morning rush hour, the community sensor recorded %s µg/m³ %s, ",
        "compared with %s µg/m³ at Marylebone Road."
      ),
      x, pol, y
    ),
    B = sprintf(
      paste0(
        "Short-term %s spikes can have important health impacts. ",
        "On %d afternoons, the community sensor recorded a mean of %s µg/m³, ",
        "compared with %s µg/m³ at Marylebone Road."
      ),
      pol, selection$n_spike_days, x, y
    ),
    C = sprintf(
      paste0(
        "During school pick-up periods, the mean %s concentration at the community sensor was %s, ",
        "whereas the mean concentration at Marylebone Road was %s. ",
        "For families, this means that children's exposure to air pollution can be comparable ",
        "to that experienced in one of London's busiest government and traffic districts."
      ),
      pol, paste0(x, " µg/m³"), paste0(y, " µg/m³")
    ),
    NULL
  )

  if (is.null(text) || is.null(footnote_mark)) {
    return(text)
  }
  sprintf("%s%s", text, footnote_mark)
}

bl_marylebone_footnote_mark <- function(index) {
  sprintf("\\textsuperscript{%d}", index + 1L)
}

bl_collect_marylebone_footnotes <- function(entries) {
  active <- Filter(function(entry) !is.null(entry$selection), entries)
  if (!length(active)) {
    return(list(footnotes = list(), marks = list()))
  }

  footnotes <- lapply(seq_along(active), function(i) {
    entry <- active[[i]]
    list(
      mark = bl_marylebone_footnote_mark(i),
      text = bl_format_marylebone_footnote(
        entry$selection,
        bl_pollutant_latex(entry$pollutant_md),
        quarter_label
      )
    )
  })
  marks <- stats::setNames(
    vapply(footnotes, function(footnote) footnote$mark, character(1)),
    vapply(active, function(entry) entry$pollutant_md, character(1))
  )
  list(footnotes = footnotes, marks = as.list(marks))
}

bl_md_to_latex_inline <- function(text) {
  gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "\\\\textbf{\\1}", text, perl = TRUE)
}

bl_format_day_list <- function(day_names) {
  days <- paste0(day_names, "s")
  if (length(days) == 1L) {
    return(days[[1]])
  }
  if (length(days) == 2L) {
    return(paste(days, collapse = " and "))
  }
  paste(paste(head(days, -1L), collapse = ", "), "and", tail(days, 1L))
}

bl_format_hour_range <- function(hours) {
  hours <- sort(unique(as.integer(hours)))
  if (!length(hours)) {
    return("unknown times")
  }
  sprintf("%s to %s", bl_format_ampm_hour(min(hours)), bl_format_ampm_hour(max(hours)))
}

bl_format_ampm_hour <- function(hour) {
  hour <- as.integer(hour)
  if (hour == 0L) {
    return("12 AM")
  }
  if (hour == 12L) {
    return("12 PM")
  }
  if (hour < 12L) {
    return(sprintf("%d AM", hour))
  }
  sprintf("%d PM", hour - 12L)
}

bl_peak_hour_window <- function(day_hours, peak_frac = 0.92, max_span = 5L) {
  day_hours <- day_hours %>% arrange(hour)
  if (!nrow(day_hours)) {
    return(integer())
  }
  peak_idx <- which.max(day_hours$mean_val)
  peak <- day_hours$mean_val[peak_idx]
  threshold <- peak * peak_frac
  left <- peak_idx
  while (left > 1L && day_hours$mean_val[left - 1L] >= threshold) {
    left <- left - 1L
  }
  right <- peak_idx
  while (right < nrow(day_hours) && day_hours$mean_val[right + 1L] >= threshold) {
    right <- right + 1L
  }
  hours <- day_hours$hour[left:right]
  if (length(hours) > max_span) {
    center <- day_hours$hour[peak_idx]
    half <- floor(max_span / 2)
    hours <- seq(center - half, center + half)
    hours <- hours[hours >= 0 & hours <= 23]
  }
  hours
}

bl_prepare_peak_data <- function(df, value_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      datetime = lubridate::ymd_hms(sub("\\..*", "", date)),
      day = as.Date(datetime),
      hour = lubridate::hour(datetime),
      weekday = lubridate::wday(datetime)
    ) %>%
    filter(between(day, quarter_start, quarter_end)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[value_col]]))
}

bl_day_names <- c(
  "Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"
)

bl_summarise_record_peak <- function(period_df, value_col, weekdays_filter) {
  filtered <- period_df %>% filter(weekday %in% weekdays_filter)
  if (!nrow(filtered)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  peak_row <- filtered %>%
    slice_max(order_by = .data[[value_col]], n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  peak_val <- peak_row[[value_col]][[1]]
  peak_day <- peak_row$day[[1]]
  peak_hour <- peak_row$hour[[1]]
  day_name <- bl_day_names[peak_row$weekday[[1]]]

  sprintf(
    "%s µg/m³ on %s, %d %s %s at %s",
    bl_format_concentration(peak_val),
    day_name,
    lubridate::day(peak_day),
    format(peak_day, "%B"),
    format(peak_day, "%Y"),
    bl_format_ampm_hour(peak_hour)
  )
}

bl_summarise_typical_peak <- function(period_df, value_col, weekdays_filter, period_name) {
  filtered <- period_df %>% filter(weekday %in% weekdays_filter)
  if (!nrow(filtered)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  by_day_hour <- filtered %>%
    group_by(weekday, hour) %>%
    summarise(mean_val = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  day_rank <- by_day_hour %>%
    group_by(weekday) %>%
    summarise(peak_val = max(mean_val), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(peak_val))

  top_val <- day_rank$peak_val[[1]]
  top_days <- day_rank$weekday[day_rank$peak_val >= top_val * 0.98]
  day_label <- bl_format_day_list(bl_day_names[top_days])

  ref_hours <- by_day_hour %>%
    filter(weekday == top_days[[1]]) %>%
    arrange(hour)
  peak_hours <- bl_peak_hour_window(ref_hours)

  sprintf(
    "%s from %s have the highest concentrations during %s",
    day_label,
    bl_format_hour_range(peak_hours),
    period_name
  )
}

bl_format_record_peak_bullet <- function(period_df, value_col) {
  weekday_peak <- bl_summarise_record_peak(period_df, value_col, 2:6)
  weekend_peak <- bl_summarise_record_peak(period_df, value_col, c(1, 7))

  if (is.null(weekday_peak) && is.null(weekend_peak)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(weekday_peak)) {
    return(sprintf(
      "The highest measurement during a weekend was %s.",
      weekend_peak
    ))
  }
  if (is.null(weekend_peak)) {
    return(sprintf(
      "The highest measurement during a weekday was %s.",
      weekday_peak
    ))
  }
  sprintf(
    "The highest measurement during a weekday was %s and for the weekend it was %s.",
    weekday_peak,
    weekend_peak
  )
}

bl_format_typical_peak_bullet <- function(period_df, value_col) {
  weekday_peak <- bl_summarise_typical_peak(period_df, value_col, 2:6, "weekdays")
  weekend_peak <- bl_summarise_typical_peak(period_df, value_col, c(1, 7), "weekends")

  if (is.null(weekday_peak) && is.null(weekend_peak)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(weekday_peak)) {
    return(bl_append_typical_peak_footnote(sprintf("On average, %s.", weekend_peak)))
  }
  if (is.null(weekend_peak)) {
    return(bl_append_typical_peak_footnote(sprintf("On average, %s.", weekday_peak)))
  }
  bl_append_typical_peak_footnote(sprintf("On average, %s and %s.", weekday_peak, weekend_peak))
}

bl_summarise_pollutant_peaks <- function(df, value_col) {
  period_df <- bl_prepare_peak_data(df, value_col)
  list(
    record = bl_format_record_peak_bullet(period_df, value_col),
    typical = bl_format_typical_peak_bullet(period_df, value_col)
  )
}

bl_emit_summary_box <- function(
    title,
    stats,
    pollutant_md,
    threshold,
    period_label,
    border_color = "blno2quarterborder",
    peak_bullets = NULL,
    marylebone_selection = NULL,
    marylebone_footnote_mark = NULL,
    last_bullet = NULL
) {
  exceed <- bl_md_to_latex_inline(
    bl_format_who_exceedance(
      stats, bl_pollutant_latex(pollutant_md), threshold, period_label
    )
  )
  conc <- bl_format_concentration_stats(stats, period_label)

  cat("\\noindent\\fcolorbox{", border_color, "}{white}{%\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\begin{minipage}{\\dimexpr\\textwidth-2\\fboxsep-2\\fboxrule\\relax}\n")
  cat("\\textbf{", title, "}\\par\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\vspace{-0.1\\baselineskip}\n") # Adjust spacing between title and content
  cat("{\\setlength{\\topsep}{0pt}\\setlength{\\partopsep}{0pt}\\setlength{\\parsep}{0pt}\\setlength{\\itemsep}{2pt}\n")
  cat("\\begin{itemize}\n")
  cat("\\item ", exceed, "\n", sep = "")
  bl_emit_annual_exceedance_sub_bullets(stats, period_label)
  cat("\\item ", conc, "\n", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(peak_bullets)) {
    if (!is.null(peak_bullets$record)) {
      cat("\\item ", peak_bullets$record, "\n", sep = "")
    }
    if (!is.null(peak_bullets$typical)) {
      cat("\\item ", peak_bullets$typical, "\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  marylebone_text <- bl_format_marylebone_paragraph(
    marylebone_selection, pollutant_md, marylebone_footnote_mark
  )
  if (!is.null(marylebone_text)) {
    cat("\\item ", marylebone_text, "\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (!is.null(last_bullet)) {
    cat("\\item ", last_bullet, "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\\end{itemize}\n")
  cat("}\n")
  cat("\\end{minipage}}\n\\vspace{1\\baselineskip}\n\n")
}

bl_prepare_no2_pm25_pair <- function(no2_df, pm25_df, quarter_start, quarter_end) {
  no2 <- no2_df %>%
    mutate(
      datetime = lubridate::ymd_hms(sub("\\..*", "", date), quiet = TRUE),
      no2 = as.numeric(no2)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(datetime), !is.na(no2)) %>%
    transmute(datetime, no2)

  pm25 <- pm25_df %>%
    mutate(
      datetime = lubridate::ymd_hms(sub("\\..*", "", date), quiet = TRUE),
      pm25 = as.numeric(pm25)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(datetime), !is.na(pm25)) %>%
    transmute(datetime, pm25)

  inner_join(no2, pm25, by = "datetime") %>%
    filter(between(as.Date(datetime), quarter_start, quarter_end))
}

bl_spike_cooccurrence_metrics <- function(pair_df, quantile = 0.75, min_paired_hours = 20L) {
  # Check if the data frame is empty or does not have enough paired hours
  if (!nrow(pair_df) || nrow(pair_df) < min_paired_hours) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Calculate the threshold for NO2 and PM2.5 based on the specified quantile
  no2_threshold <- stats::quantile(pair_df$no2, quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
  pm25_threshold <- stats::quantile(pair_df$pm25, quantile, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Flag spikes for NO2 and PM2.5
  flagged <- pair_df %>%
    mutate(
      # Flag NO2 and PM2.5 spikes as TRUE if the concentration is greater than the threshold
      no2_spike = no2 >= no2_threshold,
      pm25_spike = pm25 >= pm25_threshold
    )

  # Count the number of NO2 spikes
  n_no2_spike <- sum(flagged$no2_spike)
  # Count the number of PM2.5 spikes
  n_pm25_spike <- sum(flagged$pm25_spike)
  # Count the number of times both spiked together
  n_both_spike <- sum(flagged$no2_spike & flagged$pm25_spike)
  # Count the number of times either spiked (union)
  n_all_spike <- sum(flagged$no2_spike | flagged$pm25_spike)

  # Return NULL if there are no spikes at all
  if (n_all_spike == 0L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Return the results as a list
  list(
    n_paired_hours = nrow(pair_df),
    n_no2_spike = n_no2_spike,
    n_pm25_spike = n_pm25_spike,
    n_both_spike = n_both_spike,
    n_all_spike = n_all_spike,
    pct_both_of_all_spikes = 100 * n_both_spike / n_all_spike,
    quantile = quantile
  )
}

bl_format_spike_cooccurrence_bullet <- function(metrics, quarter_label, footnote_mark = NULL) {
  if (is.null(metrics)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  no2_pol <- bl_pollutant_latex("NO~2~")
  pm25_pol <- bl_pollutant_latex("PM~2.5~")

  text <- sprintf(
    paste0(
      "In %s, there were %d hour%s where the highest concentration spikes in ",
      "%s and %s happened at the same time, accounting for %s of all concentration spikes."
    ),
    quarter_label,
    metrics$n_both_spike,
    if (metrics$n_both_spike == 1L) "" else "s",
    no2_pol,
    pm25_pol,
    bl_format_latex_pct(metrics$pct_both_of_all_spikes)
  )

  if (is.null(footnote_mark)) {
    return(text)
  }
  sprintf("%s%s", text, footnote_mark)
}

bl_spike_cooccurrence_footnote_mark <- function(marylebone_footnote_count) {
  sprintf("\\textsuperscript{%d}", marylebone_footnote_count + 2L)
}

bl_spike_cooccurrence_methodology_text <- function(quantile = BL_SPIKE_COOCCURRENCE_QUANTILE) {
  top_pct <- sprintf("%d\\%%", as.integer(100 * (1 - quantile)))
  paste(
    sprintf(
      paste0(
        "Air pollutant spikes are the highest %s of hourly concentrations for each pollutant ",
        "at this sensor within the report quarter, using paired measurements at the same timestamp. ",
        "The percentage reported is simultaneous spike hours as a share of all hours where either ",
        "NO\\textsubscript{2} or PM\\textsubscript{2.5} spiked."
      ),
      top_pct
    )
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Strip sub-second precision, tag day-of-week, split date/time, and format hour as HH:MM
parse_hourly <- function(df) {
  df$date    <- gsub("\\..*", "", df$date)
  df$weekday <- lubridate::wday(lubridate::ymd_hms(df$date))
  df         <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(time = sub("^\\S+\\s+", "", date))
  df         <- separate(df, date, into = c("Date2", "time2"), sep = "^\\S*\\K\\s+")
  df$Date2   <- as.Date(df$Date2)
  df$time2   <- NULL
  df <- within(df, {
    posb  <- as.POSIXlt(time, format = "%H:%M:%S")
    hours <- posb$hour
    time  <- format(posb, "%H:%M")
    posb  <- NULL
  })
  pad      <- mapply(function(x, y) paste0(rep(x, y), collapse = ""), 0, 4 - nchar(df$hours))
  df$hours <- format(strptime(paste0(pad, df$hours), format = "%M%H"), format = "%H:%M")
  df
}

# Compute diurnal means for all data and the current quarter, labelled for the plot legend
hourly_means_df <- function(df, value_col, quarter_label) {
  mean_fn <- function(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), BL_REPORT_ROUND_DIGITS)
  means_all <- df %>% group_by(hours) %>% summarise_at(value_col, list(mean = mean_fn))
  means_quarter <- df %>%
    filter(between(Date2, quarter_start, quarter_end)) %>%
    group_by(hours) %>% summarise_at(value_col, list(mean = mean_fn))
  means_all$name     <- "All data to date"
  means_quarter$name <- quarter_label
  rbind(means_all, means_quarter)
}

# Parse dates and tag weekday number for both pollutants
NO2_parsed  <- parse_hourly(NO2_DATA_FRAME)
PM25_parsed <- parse_hourly(PM25_DATA_FRAME)

# Split each pollutant into weekday (Mon–Fri) and weekend (Sat–Sun) subsets
NO2_weekdays  <- NO2_parsed  %>% filter(weekday %in% 2:6)
NO2_weekends  <- NO2_parsed  %>% filter(weekday %in% c(1, 7))
PM25_weekdays <- PM25_parsed %>% filter(weekday %in% 2:6)
PM25_weekends <- PM25_parsed %>% filter(weekday %in% c(1, 7))

# Build plot data frames: all-data hourly mean + quarter hourly mean, for each group
NO2_plot_df            <- hourly_means_df(NO2_weekdays,  "no2",  quarter_label)
PM2.5_plot_df          <- hourly_means_df(PM25_weekdays, "pm25", quarter_label)
NO2_plot_weekends_df   <- hourly_means_df(NO2_weekends,  "no2",  quarter_label)
PM2.5_plot_weekends_df <- hourly_means_df(PM25_weekends, "pm25", quarter_label)
```
